description:
## Background

Refresh health belongs to the confirmed Current Workspace identity. The transition gate already clears its stored refresh health when that identity changes, but `App` mirrors health in separate React state and clears that mirror only for a `clearSnapshot` decision. A normal Workspace A → Workspace B `commitSnapshot` can therefore leave Workspace A's refresh warning visible over Workspace B.

This behavior must be fixed before the Issue Explorer coordinator refactor establishes its baseline; otherwise the refactor may hide an accidental behavior change.

Triage: `ready-for-agent`.

## What to build

When a successful Workspace transition commits a different Current Workspace identity, clear the prior Workspace's refresh-health presentation. Preserve refresh health for in-place refreshes of the same Workspace.

## Technical Approach

- Add an App-level regression test that loads Workspace A, publishes a Health refresh warning for A, and commits Workspace B.
- Assert that A's warning disappears when B's Issue Explorer snapshot becomes current.
- Apply the transition gate's computed health reset to the React presentation on every admitted identity change rather than only on `clearSnapshot`.
- Keep the change narrowly scoped; do not begin the coordinator extraction or consolidate unrelated presentation state in this issue.

## Considerations

- A same-Workspace Snapshot refresh must not clear a current Health warning unless a Health event does so.
- Pending Workspace presentation must continue retaining the previous successful snapshot for cancellation.
- Current Workspace and its matching Issue Explorer snapshot must still publish atomically.
- Do not change `data-workspace-key` behavior beyond the existing committed-identity rules.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A Health warning for Workspace A is removed when Workspace B becomes Current.
- [ ] An in-place refresh for the same Workspace retains marker, Issue List View, search, selected Issue, and applicable refresh health.
- [ ] The regression is covered through the rendered App interface.
- [ ] No coordinator extraction or unrelated state restructuring is included.
- [ ] `mise run verify` passes.

## Test Plan

- Add the A-health → B-commit regression case to `src/App.issue-refresh.test.tsx` or the most focused existing App Workspace-switching suite.
- Run `mise run ts:test` while iterating.
- Run `mise run verify` before completion.
- No new desktop E2E scenario is required; the renderer integration test covers this presentation rule.
title: Clear refresh health when Current Workspace identity changes
